response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and some low-latency DLang backend work, but the role requires deep hardware expertise in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator performance analysis, GPU architecture, and hardware-software co-design. There is no evidence of chip architecture, deep-learning workload optimization, or performance modeling at the hardware level, making this a fundamental domain mismatch despite the candidate's seniority in software development.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience, exceeding the years-of-experience bar
Some low-latency, high-throughput systems work (async I/O, fibers, caching in DLang)
Strong open-source contributions, testing culture, and knowledge-sharing track record
concerns: No SoC, IP modeling, or hardware architecture experience whatsoever
No deep-learning training/inference optimization or GPU/accelerator workload background
Career trajectory is web/product engineering, not principal-level performance architecture

key_factors.factor: No AI/DL workload or GPU optimization background
General seniority and systems programming exposure
